name: float-margins
note: A left float with margin, padding and a 2px border. The float's margin box (12px on every side) defines both the space its border box occupies and how much line boxes must give up: intrusion is 12+80+12 = 104px for the float's full margin-box height (12+56+12 = 80px).

harvest.html: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog and runs around the padded blue box that sits beside this paragraph of text.
